tldr: Permanent prevention and delayed failure are distinct treatment outcomes. Under known unbounded exponential censoring the randomized cure contrast is identified, while honest precision depends on cure rarity and unknown latency. The paper proves the evaluated all-rarity finite-sample honest-length frontier on the exact Lipschitz parent and on the matching envelope parent, with one rarity-blind attaining interval for each experiment. The profile has the n^{-1/2} and n^{-1/4} elbows, excludes additional n^{-3/8} and log-log elbows, and yields a logarithmic smoothness gain on the explicit near-null sequence rho_n=min{1/4,n^{-1/2}}. Endpoint-canceling bounded scores, an independent pilot, finite-sample Bernstein calibration, and lawful full-mark testing alternatives give matching upper and lower bounds against all randomized connected intervals.
